propertySets.name: Pset_DistributionSystemTypeOverheadContactlineSystem
propertySets.definition: Properties of an overhead contact line system. The property set is associated with the predefined type OVERHEAD_CONTACT_LINE_SYSTEM of IfcDistributionSystem.

properties.name: SpanNominalLength
properties.definition: The length of span as a design parameter for the overhead contactline system.

properties.name: ContactWireStagger
properties.definition: Lateral displacement of the contact wire to opposite sides of the track centre at successive supports.

properties.name: ContactWireNominalDrop
properties.definition: Vertical distance between the main catenary wire and the contact wire measured at a support point.

properties.name: PressureRange
properties.definition: Allowable maximum and minimum working pressure (relative to ambient pressure).

properties.name: ContactWireNominalHeight
properties.definition: Nominal distance from the top of the rail to the lower face of the contact wire, measured perpendicular to the track.

properties.name: ContactWireUplift
properties.definition: Vertical upward movement of the contact wire due to the force produced from the pantograph.

properties.name: ElectricalClearance
properties.definition: The recommended air clearances between earth and the live parts of the overhead contactline system.

properties.name: NumberOfOverlappingSpans
properties.definition: Number of overlapping spans in the overhead contactline system.

properties.name: PantographType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of pantograph as a design parameter for the overhead contactline system.

properties.name: TensionLength
properties.definition: Length of overhead contactline between two terminating points. It is a design parameter for the overhead contactline system.

properties.name: OCSType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of overhead contactline system (OCS).
